content.short: Aims to make the revolution of fairtrade, the biggest worldwide decentralised e-commerce cooperative.
content.description:
Camelcoin is a cryptocurrency and blockchain project that aims to develop and democratize camel’s products worldwide by creating financial activities within isolated communities. It is a fairtrade revolution that will be first used especially for camel’s products but its ecosystem will be usable for many other products especially natural and rare products. The ecosystem include a new blockchain, a revolutionary wallet, an e-commerce platform, a NFT program and much more.

Now we are a Cardano token and we are very attractive to the cardano community while we share values and also our wallet will be a cardano asset reference. We can describe the camelcoin project as the world biggest cooperative with sharing profits between all users.
